name: summer story
source:
Depending on your chosen path, the game unfolds in different ways:

Male protagonist — you receive a mysterious book. Will you try to uncover its meaning, or ignore it and experience the three acts differently?

Female protagonist — you receive an enigmatic letter. Will you solve the mystery of who wrote it, or set it aside and shape the three acts in your own way?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4208680]Steam[/url]]
